# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This corpus is dominated by **non-sales operational chatter** — transporter/trailer coordination (Raipur, Nagpur, Tirupati trailers), driver/loading calls, MTC/TC/tag documentation disputes (Uniqcore Vinoth), production-floor coil-cutting instructions (Yuvraj Operator), and several personal/wrong-number/social calls (Vishal threads). These were excluded per instructions.

The genuine **sales calls** that remain are mostly **inbound/outbound trade enquiries** from fabricators, structural contractors, traders, and re-sellers across Tamil Nadu and neighbouring states (Tirupati/AP, Vizag, Raipur/Chhattisgarh corridor) buying **TMT rebar, MS plates/sheets, structural sections (ISMB/channel/angle), and flats**. Most calls are short
